title: No way to serialize Generic6DOFJoint3D
body: ### Tested versions v4.6.1.stable.custom_build [14d19694e] ### System information Godot v4.6.1.stable (14d19694e) - Debian GNU/Linux 13 (trixie) 13 on Wayland - Wayland display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Mobile) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce GTX 950 (nvidia) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i3-6100 CPU @ 3.70GHz (4 threads) - 15.48 GiB memory ### Issue description I have a chain of RigidBody3D and Generic6DOFJoint3D nodes. RigidBody3D nodes can be saved in PackedScene just fine. Unfortunately Generic6DOFJoint3D do not update their transform at runtime, and I suspect some other internal state is also not serialized. This makes them unusable because the bodies has moved and the joints stayed in the initial position. I tried reconstructing them from the basis of the rigid bodies and placing the joint in-between them as such: `joint.position = Vector3.RIGHT * joint_body_a.basis * link_length / 2` While this places the joints in the correct position and the chain behaves like it should, the links are very slightly misaligned. I assume this method of reconstruction is wrong due to floating point precision or some missing internal state? I checked PhysicsServer3D and there are no methods exposed to get/set the state of the joints. Is it possible to serialize a setup like this? ### Steps to reproduce 1. Create a chain of RigidBody3D and Generic6DOFJoint3D nodes 2. Move them around in game 3. Save current scene ``` var pack = PackedScene.new() pack.pack(get_tree().current_scene) ResourceSaver.save(pack, "res://save.res") ``` 4. Open saved scene in the editor 5. Play current scene ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) I will provide if needed after discussing the issue
